# ankra_morpheus_credential (Resource)

An HPE Morpheus API credential. The counterpart of `ankra credentials morpheus create` and `ankra credentials delete`.

**Changes.** Changing `access_token` rotates the secret in place: the platform checks the new value with the provider and stores it only when the provider accepts it, otherwise the apply fails and the credential keeps its secret. `display_name` also changes in place. The other settings identify what the credential connects to, so changing them replaces the credential.

**Drift.** The platform never returns a secret, so a secret changed outside Terraform is not detected; the name, the display name and the credential's existence are, and so are `api_url` and `tls_insecure`. A platform from before 2026-10-18 does not list these settings, and a setting the platform could not read is not listed; either way the value in state is kept rather than reported as changed.

**Permissions.** The API token needs `credentials.read` as well as `credentials.write` (and `credentials.delete` to destroy): the provider reads the credential listing right after a create to fill in the read-only attributes. If that read fails, the credential is kept in state and marked tainted, so run `terraform untaint` to keep it. (A platform from before 2026-10-18 does not answer a create with the credential's id; there the error names the `terraform import` to run.)

**Projects.** A credential belongs to the provider's project. After the provider's `project_id` changes, a credential from the old project is reported as not visible in the current scope; it is neither recreated nor reported destroyed.

**Refresh cost.** Every refresh reads the credential listing for this provider. For AWS credentials the platform reads each AWS credential's secret to fill in `scope` and `auth_method`, so a refresh costs one secret read per AWS credential in the organisation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_morpheus_credential" "main" {
  name         = "morpheus-main"
  api_url      = "https://morpheus.example"
  access_token = var.morpheus_access_token
}

variable "morpheus_access_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) HPE Morpheus access token. Changing it rotates the secret in place.
- `api_url` (String) HPE Morpheus API URL, without a user name or password. Changing it replaces the credential. A change made outside Terraform shows as drift.
- `name` (String) Credential name, unique per provider in the organisation. Changing it replaces the credential.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Label shown instead of the name in the Ankra portal. Changed in place. Left unset, the label set in the portal (if any) is kept and read back; removing it from the configuration does not clear it.
- `jumphost` (Attributes) SSH jumphost the platform tunnels through to reach the API. Changing it replaces the credential. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jumphost))
- `tls_insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification for the API URL. Changing it replaces the credential. A change made outside Terraform shows as drift. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the platform considers the credential usable.
- `created_at` (String) When the credential was created.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the credential: the value cluster resources take as `credential_id` or `ssh_key_credential_id`.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state the platform reports, such as `up`.

<a id="nestedatt--jumphost"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jumphost`

Required:

- `host` (String) Jumphost address.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) SSH private key for the jumphost.

Optional:

- `port` (Number) Jumphost SSH port. Defaults to `22`.
- `username` (String) Jumphost SSH user. Defaults to `root`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Credentials are imported by id. The platform never returns a credential's secrets,
# so the first apply after an import adopts the configured values without replacing it.
terraform import ankra_morpheus_credential.main 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
